jobs.description: Job opportunity: Senior US Finance Manager Not using Sensi yet? Join senior care innovators in Orlando on Sep 27 for Sensi by the Sea. Learn More. Close Search We’re Hiring ← All Jobs Senior US Finance Manager Austin TX · Full-time · Senior About The Position Why Sensi? At Sensi.AI, we are on a mission to transform how society cares for every older adult in need. We leverage the power of AI and data to ensure safety, dignity, and satisfaction in every caregiver–care recipient interaction. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and want to help shape the future of elder care, we invite you to join our team. Here, you'll be part of a culture that values innovation and compassion, and you'll find exciting opportunities for professional growth as we work together to create an ideal care environment for older adults. About the Role Sensi.AI is looking for a hands-on Senior Controller to own the accounting, billing and finance operations for our U.S. entity. This person will report to the Director of Finance and will be responsible for the U.S. entity books, monthly close, U.S. payroll through our PEO, commissions, Mesh / spend management workflows, U.S. sales tax compliance, and billing-related accounting support. This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to own execution while helping build scalable finance processes in a fast-growing SaaS company. We are an AI-forward company, and we are looking for someone who is excited to use AI and automation tools to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and strengthen finance processes What You’ll Do Own the U.S. entity books and monthly close process. Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, payroll entries, commissions, and close schedules. Own the U.S. payroll process through our PEO, including updates, payroll review, submission, and related accounting. Own commission calculations and payment coordination. Manage Mesh / spend management accounting, including coding, receipts, approvals, and NetSuite sync. Manage the existing AR billing function and own revenue and AR processes. Own U.S. sales tax and state reporting processes, including multi-state filings and coordination with advisors. Identify manual finance processes and use AI / automation tools to improve workflows, controls, and reporting. Support audits, tax filings, compliance, and investor diligence requests. Requirements 5+ years of accounting, controllership, or similar finance experience in a fast growing SAAS startup company. CPA qualified. Experience owning books for a U.S. entity. Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP. Hands-on NetSuite experience. Experience with monthly close, reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting. Experience owning or managing U.S. payroll processes, ideally through a PEO. Experience with commissions or sales compensation processes. Familiarity with U.S. sales tax / multi-state reporting. Experience with spend management tools such as Mesh, Ramp, Brex, Airbase, or similar. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills. Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to operate independently. Experience using AI tools or automation to improve finance/accounting workflows. Experience supporting audits and tax filings. Management experience. Experience working with C - Level executives. Nice to Have. Experience with Chargebee, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems. Experience supporting investor diligence. Experience building a fast growing finance team. You’ll Be a Great Fit If You Are Hands-on and comfortable owning execution. Detail-oriented but also process-minded. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Billing, HR, and FP&A. Practical about automation and excited to improve how finance operates. Able to bring structure, ownership, and scalability to a growing U.S. finance function. jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist- West Coast Remote · Full-time · Mid-level
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Customer Onboarding Specialist- West Coast Not using Sensi yet? Join senior care innovators in Orlando on Sep 27 for Sensi by the Sea. Learn More. Close Search We’re Hiring ← All Jobs Customer Onboarding Specialist- West Coast Remote · Full-time · Mid-level About The Position About the Role Sensi sits at the intersection of AI, aging care, and real human support. Our technology helps home care agencies better understand what is happening inside the homes they serve, but successful adoption depends on more than the technology itself. It requires strong training, clear communication, hands-on support, and trusted relationships with the people using it every day. We are looking for a Customer Onboarding Specialist / Implementation Manager to lead onsite deployments with home care agencies across the United States. This is one of the most impactful client-facing roles at Sensi and one of the few conducted primarily in person. You will serve as the trainer, coach, relationship-builder, and onsite implementation expert for agencies adopting Sensi’s technology. Your job is to make sure agencies not only install the product correctly, but truly understand how to use it, explain it, and integrate it into their care model with confidence. This is a highly hands-on role. You will travel frequently, work directly with agency teams and older adults in the home, lead training for non-technical users, support light technical setup, and help drive strong adoption after deployment. ﻿What You’ll Do Lead onsite deployments with home care agencies, including device setup, router installation, staff training, and hands-on implementation support. Train agency teams on how to use Sensi’s technology, understand key workflows, and confidently explain the product to clients, families, and internal stakeholders. Serve as the onsite teacher, coach, and trusted advisor who helps non-technical users feel comfortable and confident with the platform. Present Sensi’s AI product and value proposition to agency teams, clients, families, and key stakeholders during field visits. Manage onboarding from post-sale through successful implementation, ensuring agencies are trained, operational, and positioned for long-term adoption. Identify training gaps, adoption risks, or operational blockers and work cross-functionally to resolve them. Build strong relationships with agency owners, care managers, caregivers, and other key client stakeholders. Support light technical troubleshooting during deployments and escalate issues when needed. Gather and document client feedback, field insights, and adoption blockers to help improve the product, customer experience, and internal processes. Maintain accurate account documentation, activity tracking, deployment notes, and status updates in HubSpot. Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, and Operations to ensure successful client outcomes. Stay involved throughout the onboarding lifecycle to help agencies maintain momentum after the onsite visit. ﻿ Travel Expectations This role requires frequent domestic travel, typically 60–75%. Candidates should expect to support approximately 10–15 agency deployments per quarter. Most onsite deployments include 2 full days onsite with the agency, plus ½ day of travel to the client and ½ day of travel returning home. Travel is conducted within the United States and may require being on the road multiple weeks per month. Whenever possible, travel will be scheduled close to the candidate’s home region to reduce transit time and support work-life balance. Requirements What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience in client relationship management, sales, customer success, implementation, training, healthcare, home care, or another client-facing role. Strong teaching, coaching, or training skills, especially with non-technical users. Excellent verbal communication and presentation ability. Ability to explain technology in a simple, clear, and engaging way. Comfort working directly with clients in person, including agency teams, care providers, older adults, and families. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to create trust quickly. Tech-savvy mindset with the ability to learn new tools, support basic setup, and troubleshoot issues in real time. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm when plans change or challenges come up onsite. Ability to manage multiple deployments, client priorities, and follow-up tasks while maintaining quality. Customer success mindset with a strong sense of ownership over adoption and outcomes. Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the United States. ﻿Nice to Have Experience in home care, senior care, healthcare, physical therapy, occupational therapy, clinical operations, or a related field. Prior experience in sales, field operations, enablement, implementation, onboarding, or customer success. Experience training internal teams, end users, or non-technical audiences. Comfort presenting to groups and keeping people engaged during training. Experience handling skeptical users, detractors, or challenging group dynamics. Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms. Experience working in a startup or fast-changing environment. Strong coachability, energy, and interest in building a career in client-facing implementation. ﻿What Success Looks Like In the first 30–45 days, you will complete product immersion, hands-on installation practice, internal training, and shadowing with experienced team members. During ramp, you will participate in approximately 4–5 weeks of shadow travel to observe client deployments, onsite installations, training sessions, and real client conversations. By Month 2 or Month 3, you should be ready to begin independently managing a portfolio of approximately 10–20 agency accounts and leading onsite or virtual deployments with support from your manager and cross-functional partners. jobs.description: Job opportunity: GTM Enablement Lead Not using Sensi yet? Join senior care innovators in Orlando on Sep 27 for Sensi by the Sea. Learn More. Close Search We’re Hiring ← All Jobs GTM Enablement Lead Austin TX · Full-time · Mid-level About The Position Why Join Sensi.AI Sensi.AI is transforming the world of home care through agentic AI, and we're just getting started. As a hyper-growth startup, every team member has the opportunity to make a real impact on people's lives while working as part of a global, collaborative team in a flexible hybrid environment. This role follows a hybrid model for Austin-based employees and remote work for candidates outside ﻿About the Role We are looking for a GTM Enablement Lead to build and scale the enablement foundation for Sensi's go-to-market organization. This person will help Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Marketing, Product, and RevOps understand the product, communicate value clearly, and execute consistently as the business scales. This is a hands-on builder role. You will own onboarding, product readiness, GTM playbooks, knowledge management, training programs, launch enablement, and reinforcement. The role requires judgment: diagnosing whether the real issue is training, messaging, process, product readiness, or manager reinforcement before building anything. You will also build repeatable GTM readiness processes from product launch through field adoption, feedback, and continuous improvement, partnering with the AI Operations Lead where tools, templates, workflows, or automation can make enablement faster and more scalable. ﻿Key Responsibilities Build and own Sensi's GTM enablement foundation, including onboarding, product training, playbooks, readiness programs, and ongoing reinforcement. Create repeatable GTM readiness processes for product launches, including intake, audience mapping, enablement plans, training, adoption tracking, and feedback loops. Translate product updates, roadmap changes, and customer insights into clear, practical materials tailored to Sales, CS, Support, Implementation, and other GTM teams. Build field-ready messaging, talk tracks, objection handling, FAQs, customer stories, demo guidance, and value frameworks that help teams communicate Sensi clearly. Own the internal knowledge base and enablement content lifecycle, ensuring materials are accurate, current, easy to find, and actively used. Design and facilitate training, workshops, certifications, and manager-led reinforcement that improve product fluency and execution quality. Diagnose GTM gaps using data, field feedback, manager input, and customer signals before deciding whether the solution is training, messaging, process, content, or product feedback. Establish an enablement intake and prioritization process based on business impact, urgency, audience, and measurable outcomes. Measure enablement effectiveness through ramp time, readiness, adoption, content usage, behavior change, field execution quality, and business impact. Partner with AI Operations to identify tools, templates, workflows, and automation that make enablement faster, easier to adopt, and more scalable. Requirements What We're Looking For Strong GTM fluency across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Product, Marketing, and RevOps. Experience building enablement programs, playbooks, onboarding, training, readiness processes, or knowledge systems from scratch. Product launch readiness experience, including audience-specific guidance, training, reinforcement, adoption tracking, and feedback loops. Ability to translate complex product concepts into simple, practical guidance for customer-facing teams. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to train teams, coach managers, and influence senior leaders. Strong business judgment and prioritization, with the ability to validate problems, push back thoughtfully, avoid overbuilding, and focus on what changes behavior. Operational discipline in ambiguous environments, with the ability to create structure without slowing teams down. B2B SaaS or startup experience, ideally in a technical product environment with a maturing GTM function. Experience supporting customer-facing teams beyond Sales, such as CS, Support, Implementation, Services, or Product-led teams. ﻿Sensi.AI celebrates diversity and upholds equal opportunity in our hiring practices. Our approach fosters an inclusive environment that sparks innovation and reflects the vibrant communities we serve. All persons shall have the opportunity to be considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. jobs.title: Prompt Engineer / Conversational Designer Austin TX · Full-time
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Prompt Engineer / Conversational Designer Not using Sensi yet? Join senior care innovators in Orlando on Sep 27 for Sensi by the Sea. Learn More. Close Search We’re Hiring ← All Jobs Prompt Engineer / Conversational Designer Austin TX · Full-time About The Position Why Join Sensi.AI Sensi.AI is transforming home care through agentic AI — and we're just getting started. Our AI listens, understands and surfaces what matters in the lives of older adults, so caregivers and families can act before a small change becomes a crisis. As a hyper-growth startup, every person here has an outsized hand in the product and a direct line to the people it helps. About the Role You'll help design the way our AI actually talks to people. Sensi runs a growing family of agents — voice, text and summarization — across multiple product lines serving home care agencies, seniors and their families. This role owns the prompts behind them. Not one agent, and not one narrow surface: you'll build new agents from the ground up for new use cases, and you'll own prompt quality across several products and several product managers at once. It is a genuinely broad, dynamic remit for an individual contributor, and you'll have an experienced prompt engineer alongside you rather than being the only person thinking about this. Concretely, that means writing and rewriting the prompts, designing the conversations, testing them against real recordings and transcripts, and iterating on what you find. You'll work directly with product managers on what an agent needs to do, and directly with engineers on how it gets built. The work is high-stakes in a way most prompt work isn't. Our users are older adults and the people who care for them. Tone, clarity and trustworthiness aren't polish here — they're the product. This role is based in Austin, TX, with a hybrid work setup , combining in-office collaboration with remote flexibility. If you're not able to commute into Austin 2-3x per week, please do not apply. Key Responsibilities ﻿ Design the conversations. Build multi-turn dialogue flows for voice and text agents, with context awareness and memory handling. Define each agent's personality and tone, and keep it consistent as the family of agents grows. Build the prompts, and build the tooling around them. Write, version and maintain a real prompt library — system prompts, flows, reusable templates. Where you need a harness or a script to test something properly, you build it. Test against reality, not vibes. Work from actual recordings, transcripts and simulations, before and after launch. Hunt hallucinations, wrong tone, dead ends and token waste in live interactions, then close the gap. Partner across the org. Take requirements and priorities from product managers; work with engineers to land prompts inside real technical constraints; support our compliance and privacy obligations. Share what you learn — this is a new enough discipline that your findings change how other teams work. Requirements What we're looking for Based in Austin - able to be in our downtown office a couple of days a week. We work closely with colleagues in Israel, so real overlap with both Austin and Israel hours matters. Roughly 1–2 years of hands-on prompt engineering — genuinely writing, building and iterating on prompts yourself. This is a young field and we're not looking for a decade of it. Evidence you've designed something, not just assessed it. The distinction matters to us: rating or ranking someone else's AI output is adjacent work, but it isn't this job. Enough technical ability to hold your own. You'll build some of your own tools and you'll be in conversations with engineers about integration and constraints. You don't need to ship production services, but you do need to figure things out quickly without becoming a bottleneck. Strong language and communication skills. A large part of this job is words — precision, tone, and explaining your reasoning to people who don't do what you do. Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and conversational frameworks (e.g., LangChain). Excellent writing and linguistic skills, with attention to tone, clarity, and cultural sensitivity. Basic programming skills (Python preferred) for testing and prototyping prompts. Strong cross functional partnership and communications skills. Nice-to-Have Background in healthtech, hardware, healthcare, caregiving, or other regulated industries. Multi-lingual proficiency. At Sensi.AI, we are on a mission to transform how society cares for every older adult in need. We leverage the power of AI and data to ensure safety, dignity, and satisfaction in every caregiver–care recipient interaction. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and want to help shape the future of elder care, we invite you to join our team. Here, you'll be part of a culture that values innovation and compassion, and you'll find exciting opportunities for professional growth as we work together to create an ideal care environment for older adults. ﻿What you will do ﻿ We're looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented IT Specialist (Student Position, 60%) to join our IT team. You'll support day-to-day IT operations, help manage our SaaS and device ecosystem, and be a go-to person for employees needing technical support. This is a great opportunity for a student who wants practical, real-world experience across modern IT tools and workflows in a fast-paced AI driven tech company. Responsibilities Deliver responsive and high-quality technical support to internal employees Support HR-IT processes and employee lifecycle (onboarding/off-boarding) sync with Bob Manage user identities, groups, access and SSO via Okta Maintain and support with the Google Workspace ecosystem Manage and support Slack workspace configuration, channels, and integrations Manage company devices (Mac) using Jamf MDM (enrollment, policies, compliance) Support employees' use of AI tools such as Claude , ChatGPT , Gemini and Lovable , Provide basic guidance on models and usage Handle IT tickets and service requests through Jira ITSM , ensuring timely resolution and proper documentation Maintain and optimize SaaS management process - tracking licenses, usage, and cost efficiency Maintain accurate inventory management of hardware and equipment (laptops, peripherals, accessories) Document processes, create internal guides, and help improve IT workflows Assist with ad-hoc IT projects as needed Requirements Currently pursuing a degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, or similar) Availability to work 60% capacity from the office on Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday from 9 AM to 6 PM (with flexibility around exam periods) Basic skills of building and maintaining AI-generated internal applications on Claude andLovable, sync to GitHub , and deploying onto AWS hosting services Strong communication skills and a service-oriented mindset Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple tasks/tickets simultaneously Quick learner with genuine interest in IT operations, SaaS, and modern workplace technology Advanced troubleshooting skills in a MacOS environments Nice to Have Prior experience or coursework related to identity/access management, device management (MDM), or IT service management Familiarity with any of the listed tools (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jamf, Jira, Cloudflare, bob) Interest in AI tools and their practical use in a business setting Apply for this position Privacy Notice contactus@sensi.ai Sensi HQ 701 Brazos Street Austin, Texas 78701 Product What’s Sensi Resources Care Intelligence Digest Insights In the Press Seniors & Families Company Meet Romi Careers Contact Us Terms and Conditions Privacy Terms of Use © Copyright Sensi.AI 2026 Close Menu Product Customers Reviews Resources Project Uplift Stories Senior Voices Care Intelligence Digest Insights In the Press Company Meet Romi, Sensi AI CEO Careers Contact Us Log In Book a Demo Home Care Agencies Seniors & Families Communities
